out.title: Persistent's takeover offer for Nagarro successful; delisting planned
out.summary: Persistent secured 83.25% of Nagarro (61.15% tendered plus 22.10% from Lantano), exceeding the 50% threshold; additional acceptance period runs September 23–October 6, 2026 at EUR 81.00/share; delisting and closing expected by end Q1 CY27.
